title: Morse Boy
description: A Morse-code trainer for the Game Boy. Decoder is a live Morse chart with keying tone, sequence and decoded-character display, in two orientations. Receive RX offers a Learn mode with 13 cumulative stages and a Practice mode covering all letters and digits, with replay, hints, streaks and three lives. Transmit TX includes a Speed Drill with randomized letter targets, a 64-word bank and a free-transmission Scratch page, all with adjustable speed from 5 to 99 WPM. Hold A to key a tone, as with a straight key. Tested in emulators only; compatibility with original hardware is unverified.
